meta.title: TesisLab — Financial Decision Audit Simulator
meta.description: Stress-test your financial decisions with Pre-Mortem analysis before committing capital.

hero.headline: Stress-Test Your Financial Plan Before Capital Leaves Your Account.
hero.subheadline: Pre-Mortem simulation grounded in deterministic math and daily macro context to expose hidden risks across trading, small business, and personal cashflow.

trading.name: Market & Trading Audit
trading.description: Inspect risk-to-reward ratio (R:R), capital drawdown limits, and market volatility sensitivity.

business.name: Business & SME Audit
business.description: Validate net profit margin, break-even point (BEP), and operating cash runway.

cashflow.name: Personal Cashflow Audit
cashflow.description: Evaluate debt service ratio (DSR), emergency fund coverage, and monthly free cashflow.

data_analyst.name: Macro & Data Analyst
data_analyst.description: Cross-checks raw numbers against daily interest rates, inflation, and liquidity conditions.

risk_manager.name: Risk Manager
risk_manager.description: Hunts for worst-case scenarios, ruin thresholds, and fragile assumptions in your plan.

committee_chair.name: Audit Committee Chair
committee_chair.description: Delivers an objective final verdict with concrete mitigation conditions prior to execution.

verdict.disclaimer: TesisLab is a deterministic risk simulation and calculation tool, not a licensed financial advisor. Final financial decisions remain solely the user's responsibility.

common.error_generic: Unable to complete the audit. Please verify your inputs and try again.
